findings.artifact: assets/objects/obj_heart_fold.png (bundled as app/assets/objects/obj_heart_fold.webp; not visible in any of the fifteen artifacts)
findings.where: the emotional layer's object set: item 27 of the 30 the 'what it looks like' drawer shows on the feeling-authoring sheet (app/lib/regions/settings/authoring.dart:148, `_drawer.take(30)`)
findings.what: A heart-emoji silhouette is in the set of objects a feeling can be made of: 1200x1200, alpha left-right symmetric to a correlation of 1.0000 (mean absolute difference 0.08 of 255), no crease, no fold facet, no cut edge and no fibre, and a 5-px tooth of 4.21 grey levels inside the shape against 6.96-19.11 measured on the paper in 01_pulse.png, 02_chat.png and 03_us.png; it is listed in app/assets/INDEX.json, ships in app/build/web/assets/assets/objects/obj_heart_fold.webp, and sits at index 26 of the 63-long sorted MaterialLibrary.objectIds, inside the first thirty the drawer renders.
findings.why: The row forbids emoji standing in for feeling anywhere in the build, and a perfectly symmetric blurred heart is the emoji shape itself rather than an object; alone of the 32 objects it has no _dusk render and no Feeling in builtins.dart names it, which is how you can tell nothing planned to draw it - but the authoring picker offers it, so it is reachable, not merely stranded.

findings.where: the `stale` block and `from_this_run: false` on every artifact but one
findings.what: Fourteen of the fifteen present artifacts were written between 2026-09-08T18:49:20Z and 20:15:25Z, against a capture that began at 22:01:33Z; only 07_feeling_landing.mp4 carries `from_this_run: true`.
findings.why: A still that predates the run is a still of an older build, so my clearance of the three visible anti-goals - voice, emoji, paper - is a clearance of the build as it stood between 18:49 and 20:15, not at 22:01; DIFF.json reports thirteen byte-identical and two changed against the previous capture, which is an argument from a hash rather than from a fresh picture.

what_is_working: No emoji glyph in anything the app displays. My own scan of 3,538 string literals across the 174 Dart files under app/lib, and of every .dart/.html/.json/.js/.md/.yaml/.txt/.xml/.kt/.css/.webmanifest file under app/, found 0 codepoints in the emoji ranges outside comments: the only 15 hits are '->' and check glyphs inside // comments in note.dart:109, transport.dart, shelf_module.dart:69, media/capture.dart:77 and four tests. The seeded year - 14,061 events, 19,165 string payload fields - carries 0 emoji as well. logs/strings.json's own scan agrees (119 strings, 0 findings), and my wider one does not contradict it.

The delivery marks are drawn, not set in a font. `read` shows two Mark.tick pen strokes in ballpoint, `sent` one, `it would not go` a Mark.cross in red, each seeded off the message id (note.dart:340-357); at 300 per cent in crops/02_chat_300_shadow.png and in 06_unfolding.mp4 the tick tapers at both ends the way a nib does. Reactions are FeelingObject renders pinned to the corner of the paper (note.dart:129-146), not glyphs - 02_chat.png's first note carries the pink wrapped sweet, not a heart.

Product-marketing voice is absent from every string I could find. Across the 76-entry S table in app/lib/voice/strings.dart and the 57 distinct hard-coded displayed literals I extracted from Text/Written/Stamped/label:/hint:/title: sites: 0 exclamation marks, 0 occurrences of 'user', 0 cheer words (oops/whoops/yay/awesome/amazing/great job/welcome/congrat/nice work/hooray), 0 onboarding voice (get started/let's go/tap here/you're all set/learn more/try it). The failure states are the test case and they pass: 'it would not go', "can't reach the other phone. it'll go when it can.", "the other phone isn't answering. keeping this until it does." - the exact three places a marketing voice writes 'Oops!'.

The app never names itself where a person can see it. web/manifest.json name and short_name, web/index.html <title> and apple-mobile-web-app-title, and AndroidManifest.xml android:label are all 'the other phone'; logs/pwa.json read the same name back off the served page. The name exists only as machine identifiers - io.lovetap.desk (applicationId), lovetap/haptics (platform channel), lovetap-pair-v1 (protocol tag), /tmp/lovetap-capture (harness path) - none of which is displayed.

Nothing counts up while you are not looking. app.dart:341-344 turns the corner of the tab card down for something unread and keeps no number; the tab strip in all ten stills shows PULSE CHAT US MOMENTS SETTINGS with no badge. web/push/sw.js shows one notification under a single tag 'from-them' so a second arrival replaces the first rather than stacking, shows nothing at all when the treatment is off, and the `badge:` key it sets is the Android status-bar monochrome icon, not a count.

The rituals surface is a tally, not a streak. _TallyPainter (rituals_module.dart:194-213) draws one stroke per keeping in each of the last eight weeks and returns without drawing anything for a week with none - no zero, no gap marker, no colour for a missed week. `ritual_kept` is notify: Notify.none with no `pushed:` line at all in spine/types.dart:296-306, so a ritual can never ping either phone. The shelf's states are passed -> started -> finished with, in its own words, nothing ever overdue and nothing ever failed.

Paper is not simulated - three measurements, one per named failure mode. (a) Not a tiled repeating texture: on 10_first_run.png's 1000x1240 clear desk region the vertical autocorrelation of the row profile decays monotonically from r=+0.36 at lag 20 with no peak out to lag 900, and the horizontal best is a broad r=+0.33 at 480 px, which is plank scale; assets/shell/desk.png is 1400x3067 and BoxFit.cover on 1440x3120 scales it to 1440x3154, so the ImageRepeat.repeatY in desk.dart:34 never gets a second copy onto the screen. (b) Not a procedural noise overlay: the radial power spectrum of the 5-px residual in a 128x128 paper patch of 02_chat.png peaks mid-band (1.00 at ring 1, 9.13 at 5, 146.7 at 15, 65.5 at 30) where synthetic white noise on the same measure rises monotonically (1.00, 1.35, 27.1, 119.3), and the wood's spectrum is different again (1.00, 34.1, 5.40, 1.23) - band-limited photographic tooth, and not one field laid over everything. (c) Not a beige rounded rectangle with a drop shadow: the 'DATES' card in 03_us.png is 705x201 px with square corners and edges that wander (top edge sigma 1.26 px over 664 columns, left edge sigma 0.85 px over 160 rows), and its shadow is 25.0 grey levels deep below, 11.2 to the right, 1.7 above and -3.8 to the left - the left edge is brighter than the far desk, which no drop shadow does.

One light, and it is sideways. Across the eight largest paper pieces in each of 02_chat.png and 03_us.png the desk is darker to the right of every piece (right-minus-left from -5.7 to -41.8 grey levels) and level above and below (-2.2 to +2.9): a raking light from the upper left, not the downward offset a box-shadow gives. crops/02_chat_300_edge.png and crops/02_chat_300_hand.png show fibre wisps standing out of the torn edge and casting their own shadows; interior tooth measures 6.96-19.11 grey levels at 5 px with saturation 3.6-16.4 per cent - white and cream stock, not a beige fill.

The emotional vocabulary is objects, not icons. 36 feelings in six families (logs/haptics.check.json, 34 built in, 2 authored); the picker sheets in 15_authored_feeling.mp4 show a cork, scattered paper confetti, paper bunting, a paper hat cone, a coiled ribbon, a crumpled ball, a wrapped sweet, a paper plane and folded card, each with a cast shadow falling the same way as the ruled sheet it lies on, and four feelings drawn in ink by the app itself. Their names - 'a squeeze', 'empty chair', "i'll make you tea", 'ugh', 'nyeh', 'grey', 'not okay' - carry no exclamation and no cheer.

The copy holds in the two hardest places. Onboarding (17_setup_pwa.png): 'add it to the home screen / share, then add to home screen. it will not hold on to anything until you do.' First run (10_first_run.png): "first one's yours. / whatever it is. it only goes to one person." Empty states: 'nothing to do. suspicious.', "nowhere planned. that's fine.", 'nothing kept yet.' None of them addresses a user, congratulates anybody, or sells the thing they are inside of.
verdict: I looked for all four forbidden interpretations and found three of them nowhere and the fourth once, in a file no picture shows. Voice: zero exclamation marks, zero 'user', zero self-naming and zero cheer across the 76-entry S table and the 57 hard-coded displayed literals I pulled out of the widget tree; the app calls itself 'the other phone' in the manifest, the title, the Apple meta and the Android label, and puts 'it would not go' where a product would put 'Oops!'. Emoji: zero codepoints in the emoji ranges in 3,538 lib literals and in 19,165 seeded payload strings; the ticks under a message are pen strokes seeded per id and reactions are rendered objects. Engagement machinery: the unread indicator is a folded corner with no number (app.dart:341), rituals draw a tally that simply stops rather than a streak that breaks and are notify: Notify.none with no push line at all, the shelf has no overdue and no failed state, and the service worker uses one tag so arrivals replace instead of piling up. The three strings that come closest - '20 times' beside a ritual, 'us in 61 days' on the calendar, 'waiting on you: the one you said you stopped' on the shelf - are each a fact about an object or a date with no target, no deadline, no notification and no failure state, and I do not think any of them crosses. Paper: the desk shows no tile period out to 900 px, the paper's fine grain is band-limited where generated noise is not, and the 'DATES' card has square corners, edges that wander a pixel or so, and a shadow 25 grey levels deep below and negative to the left because the light rakes in from the upper left - none of the three named failure modes is present, in day or at dusk. What stops this being a ten is obj_heart_fold: a 1200x1200 heart, symmetric to a correlation of 1.0000 with no crease, no cut edge and a quarter of the paper's tooth, which ships in the bundle, is listed in INDEX.json and sits inside the thirty objects the feeling-authoring drawer offers - the emoji shape itself, in the emotional layer, offered rather than merely stranded. It appears in none of the fifteen artifacts, so it costs one point and not more. The second mark against the set is that fourteen of those fifteen artifacts predate this capture by three hours or so, which means what I have cleared is the build that produced them.
